motion.name: settings-ease
motion.purpose: Sidebar selection and Advanced disclosure. Skipped when Reduce Motion is on.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Violet Add account and empty-state action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #B56BFF; color: #F4F1F8; padding: 0 12px; height: 28px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; font: 500 12.5px/1 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #B56BFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secret Field
components.description: Keychain secret with reveal and violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-secret { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: #A8A3B5; font: 500 11px/1.3 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-secret input { height: 30px; background: #12111A; color: #F4F1F8; border: 1px solid #B4AACC2E; border-radius: 7px; padding: 0 10px; } .ds-secret input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #B56BFF; border-width: 1.5px; }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Selected Settings rail row with full-row violet wash.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #A8A3B5; font: 500 12.5px/1 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; width: 100%; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-item.is-selected { background: rgba(181,107,255,0.16); color: #F4F1F8; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:hover:not(.is-selected) { background: rgba(244,241,248,0.06); }

components.name: Settings Group
components.description: Single grouped preference surface. Never nested.
components.css: .ds-group { background: #24222C; color: #F4F1F8; border: 1px solid #B4AACC2E; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 36px; font: 500 13px/1.3 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: QuotaBar is a menu-bar utility, not a settings product. Settings must feel like the dark popover opened one notch wider. Surfaces are purple-tinted dark neutrals. One violet accent does selection, focus, and primary actions.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained: tinted dark neutrals + one purple accent
Sidebar + one pane (never an endless card wall)
SF Pro only; SF Mono for pasted JSON
Tonal elevation (lighter = higher), no drop shadows
Provider hues stay on 12pt icons, never on full-width fills

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Purple accent occupies ≤10% of Settings: primary actions, current sidebar row, focus, and toggle-on.

rules.name: The Tinted Night Rule
rules.body: Settings neutrals lean violet. Do not use #000, #fff, or untinted gray. Do not restyle popover meters.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: SF Pro for every Settings label. No display face. Group labels are 10.5 medium dusk, title case.

rules.name: The Flat Night Rule
rules.body: If you can see a drop shadow, remove it. If a group is nested inside a group, flatten it.

dos: Do keep Settings in the Night Menu Extra register: dark, dense, native.
Do put every Settings color through Theme tokens.
Do collapse Advanced cookie/JSON by default.
Do teach empty ChatGPT and OpenCode lists with a next action.
Do leave Keychain account names and config.json keys unchanged.
donts: Don't clone bright macOS System Settings (large white grouped lists, toolbar icon grid).
Don't stack identical icon-title-hint cards down an endless window.
Don't use border-left / side-stripe accents on rows or groups.
Don't fill primary buttons with teal, green, amber, or blue; violet is the only action fill.
Don't nest cards, add glass blur, gradient text, or decorative motion.
Don't restyle popover meter geometry or rewrite NSPopover.contentSize.
